corrective_action: Establish standardized energy-efficiency KPIs baselines data collection and reporting procedures
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a)
evidence_basis: The policy requires energy-efficient low-emission and environmentally friendly technologies but does not establish common operator-level indicators targets baselines or reporting methods.

corrective_action: Adopt standardized reporting indicators units baselines and reporting procedures for energy consumption energy savings and energy reduction
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a)
evidence_basis: Operators report energy-efficiency performance using different levels and forms of quantitative evidence making direct comparison difficult.

corrective_action: Standardize reporting of renewable-energy capacity generation consumption share and renewable-powered sites using consistent indicators and units
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Sections 5.1.3-5.1.4
evidence_basis: Operators report renewable-energy adoption using different measures and units including solar-powered sites kWp GWh GJ and percentage of network sites.

corrective_action: Improve access to renewable-energy procurement mechanisms and address technical contractual and implementation barriers affecting large-scale renewable-energy adoption
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Sections 5.1.3-5.1.7
evidence_basis: Large-scale renewable-energy procurement depends on supporting regulatory and contractual mechanisms and reported implementation challenges affect renewable-energy scaling.
responsible_actor: Mobile operators and relevant government and energy-sector authorities

corrective_action: Establish a consistent operator-level GHG inventory with defined reporting boundaries KPIs data collection procedures and regular disclosure
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Banglalink does not provide sufficient operator-level GHG data for direct comparison and the three operators disclose different levels of GHG information.

corrective_action: Establish common GHG reporting boundaries baselines units calculation methods and disclosure formats
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Operators report different GHG measures baselines and levels of detail making direct comparison difficult.

corrective_action: Establish internal GHG reduction planning monitoring responsibilities and regular progress reviews against the operator's own reduction pathway or target
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d); operator-reported targets
evidence_basis: Grameenphone reports Scope 1 and 2 emissions above its 2019 baseline while maintaining a 2030 reduction target. Performance should be assessed against the operator's stated reduction pathway rather than treated as automatic policy non-compliance.

corrective_action: Establish standardized collection recycling reuse and disposal KPIs with defined reporting categories and regular operator-level disclosure
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Section 14.3
evidence_basis: Grameenphone reports 1163.94 tonnes of e-waste recycled while Banglalink lacks sufficient quantitative operator-level data and Robi does not clearly separate telecom-specific e-waste.

corrective_action: Standardize telecom e-waste reporting categories units reporting boundaries and calculation procedures across operators
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c)
evidence_basis: Operators provide different levels of detail and do not consistently report comparable telecom-specific e-waste quantities.

corrective_action: Strengthen measurable infrastructure-sharing practices and establish standardized reporting of shared facilities coverage arrangements and environmental benefits
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 5.3 7.2.8 7.7 and 13.6
evidence_basis: Policy supports active and passive infrastructure sharing but sufficient quantitative operator-level information is unavailable to measure the extent of sharing or its environmental benefits.

corrective_action: Establish standardized monitoring and reporting of tower fiberization progress against applicable policy milestones
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.2.5
evidence_basis: The policy sets targets of 50% tower fiberization within 1.5 years and 80% within three years but sufficient operator-level data are unavailable to verify progress.

corrective_action: Strengthen regulatory coordination government support incentives and procurement mechanisms that facilitate renewable-energy implementation
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.12; Clause 11.11(b)
evidence_basis: Reported challenges in large-scale renewable-energy procurement indicate that government and regulatory support mechanisms can affect Green ICT implementation.
responsible_actor: BTRC and relevant government and energy-sector authorities

corrective_action: Strengthen coordination between network-resilience requirements and lower-emission backup power options while maintaining required network reliability
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.2.7
evidence_basis: The policy requires diesel generators at 25% of tower sites in disaster-prone areas to maintain network resilience while continued diesel use can increase fuel consumption and emissions.
